def transform(grid):
    blocks=[ [row[i:i+4] for row in grid] for i in (0,5,10,15)]
    # On overlaps, priority is 9, then 4, then 8, then 5.
    priority=(9,4,8,5)
    return [[next((c for c in priority if any(b[y][x]==c for b in blocks)),0) for x in range(4)] for y in range(4)]
